cs.t: Sure. My chromebooks were $69 on Woot. They clearly came from a school. My main machine is a 17” $600 Asus gaming laptop with 970M. It was $1500 new and runs like a dream. My iPad 4 was used. My iPhone 8 Plus was used. I pay 50% or less for all used technology. I know when I see a good deal, which is not true for many people.
